profile.headline: Maker and Developer of Things
profile.summary:
I am a seasoned application developer with over seven years of experience operating with all levels of the development cycle, various technology stacks, and deployment environments.  I enjoy solving complex problems, and delivering beyond the customer's expectations.  I love researching new technology, documenting what I found, and sharing that with folks to help them to navigate the solution space to find the best fit.  Research, educate, solve!

Specialties: VB.NET	
C#.NET
ASP.NET
MSSQL data management	
Object Orientated Programming
C++	
ClickOnce
Java	
Microsoft Reporting Services	
Windows OS environment
Agile	
Team Foundation Server

positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description:
(Formerly Travel and Transport)

• Add, enhance, and maintain an increasing number of public and private facing web sites, forms, and displays for clients, agents, and the general public.

• Create and monitor a host of critical back office applications from email parsing, automated log file compression and archiving, and daily file transfers for accurate data for the agents.

• Provide the point of contact for updates with the traveler monitoring program to help various clients to save money with their travelers as well as maintain corporate travel policies.  This means adding and modifying existing rules to the system, but also integration into various mobile applications for the travelers.  

• Creating various desktop quality tracking for different agent branches.  These applications were to be unobtrusive input on agent activities with complex reporting and modification for quality assurance statistics.

• Work in a fairly independent environment with responsibilities to collect detailed user requirements, measure feasibility, develop the product, and implement it for user satisfaction.

• Create complete documentation for user guides, testing outlines, and maintenance records.

positions.title: Technical Reviewer
positions.description: I contracted with Microsoft Press as a technical reviewer of "Exam Ref 70-533 Implementing Microsoft Azure Infrastructure Solutions" (978-0735697065).  I tested the coding examples, reviewed technical concepts for clarity and accuracy, and assisted presenting the information in a focused and effective manner.

positions.title: Technical Reviewer
positions.description: I contracted with Microsoft Press as a technical reviewer of "Adaptive Code via C#: Agile coding with design patterns and SOLID principles" (978-0735683204).  I tested the coding examples, reviewed technical concepts for clarity and accuracy, and assisted presenting the information in a focused and effective manner.

positions.title: Web Developer II
positions.description: Maintained forward facing websites, created back office applications to stream line data collection and distribution, and maintained existing in house applications while on contract.

positions.title: Sr Application Developer
positions.description:
•	Develop and maintain new systems using .NET (VB/C#), MS SQL, and MS Reporting Services.
•	Followed end to end life cycle of a project translating customer requirements into appropriate enhancements and solutions.
•	Lead a team of developers in code reviews, scheduled patch releases, and integration of multiple shelvesets of code.
•	Operated as the project’s release manager for all production and test environment patch updates..

positions.title: Software Tester - QA QA Analyst Technician
positions.description:
•	Review project design, and thoroughly test all new functionality.
•	Regression test for existing system impacts caused by new installation.
•	Specialization in new testing areas migrating to my department: specifically our fraud products.
•	Design, program, and execute QARun and TestPartner scripts with extensive VB automation modifications on the back end.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Analyst
positions.description:
•	Review recorded operator calls to insure they are with in FDR operational guidelines.
•	Provide timely feedback to operators on levels of service provided to the company and clients.
•	Coach operators in problem areas to maintain First Data standards.

positions.title: Team Lead
positions.description:
•	Sustained day-to-day operations of the department, performed managerial functions, and assisted client support.
•	Supported training of new hires, and answered operator questions on our products.
•	Provide quality assurance feedback with log sheet monitoring to help insure great service

positions.title: Fraud Analyst II
positions.description:
•	Quickly and efficiently take reports within First Data Guidelines for our various products.
•	Assist the clients with issues relating to their accounts.
•	Maintain confidentiality and adhere to special bank procedures.

honors.title: Above and Beyond
honors.description: Recognition of going above and beyond what is normally expected of an employee.
